source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 23 aprilie — «Sfântul Mucenic Valerie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Ουαλέριος ο Μάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him. The whole body of the page is one sentence: «Ο Άγιος Μάρτυς Ουαλέριος τελειώθηκε διά ξίφους» — he was perfected by the sword; and that is one fact more than the Romanian calendar gave, which named him and no more. The page gives no year, so the folder's empty `dates` were left empty; it names no country, no city and no judge, and prints no hymn and no relic. It stands among the entries of the great martyr George's day, but — unlike the pages of Anatolius, Protoleon and Glycerius — it says nothing to tie him to George's passion, and nothing of the kind was supplied. The corpus's other Valerius is one of the Forty of Sebaste.
